title: Video by avani.codes (Important 6 Files to Create before Vibe Coding)
description:
Comment 'VIBE' to get Step by step guide.

If you're building apps with AI coding tools, these files can help keep your project organized and give AI better context:

1. PRD.md - Product requirements
2. ARCHITECTURE.md - Project architecture
3. RULES.md - Coding rules
4. DESIGN.md - UI/UX direction
5. TASKS.md - Tasks & progress
6. MEMORY.md - Project context

Save this before your next Vibe Coding project!
summary: Avani Hiranandani demonstrates the crucial 6-file documentation setup under docs/ that prevents AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity) from producing disorganized code or context drift during vibe coding. Tasks should be tackled phase-by-phase with clear state tracking.
